paite: Huan omkhawm tengteng aw suah in akap ua; huai zan in mite akap uhi.
heading: Mipite Phunna
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

paite: Israel suan tengteng Mosi tung leh Aaron tung ah aphun ua; omkhawm tengteng in akiang uah, "Aigupta gam ah Pathian in hon that geih hileh aw! Ahihkeileh gamdai ah hon na that geih hileh aw!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

paite: Bang achia namsau a si maimah dia Pathian in hiai gam a hon pi ahi diam aw? I zi leh i tate lah mat maimah ding ahi ngal ua. Aigupta gam a kik nawn ei a dia hoihzaw lou ding hia? achi uhi.
english: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

paite: Huchi in akihoukhawm ua, heutu bawl ni e, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn ni," achi uhi.
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng ma ah Mosi leh Aaron abokkhup uhi.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb, gam va enkhete lak a telte'n apuan uh abotkek uh.
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

paite: Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah, "Enkhe dia ka va vakna gam uh gam hoihtak ahi.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

paite: I tung ua TOUPA akipahleh huai gam ah ahon pilut ngei ding. Huai nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pe ding hi.
english: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

paite: TOUPA tung ah hel kei phot le uchin. Huai gam a mite leng lau sam kei un. I an ding uh ahi ua, akihumbitna uh bangmah ahi kei. TOUPA i kiang uah a-om hi, amau lau kei un," chi in agen uhi.
english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

paite: Himahleh omkhawm tengteng in suang a den asawm ua; huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk, Israel suan tengteng ma ah TOUPA thupina ahong kilangta hi.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. Yahweh’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bang tan hon thusim lou ding ahi ua; alak ua chiamtehna ka hih zel nangawn a leng bang tan ahia hon taksan louh lai ding uh?
heading: Mipite Ding In Mosi Athum
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

paite: Hipi in ka gawt dia, ka in-gamsak dia, nangmah ah amau sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw nam ka bawlkhe zaw mai ding,” achi hi.
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aigupta mite'n aza kha ding uh. Hiai mite lah alak ua pan na thilhihtheihna a na pikhiakte ahi ngal ua.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

paite: Hiai gam a teng mite ahilh ding uh. Hiai mite lak ah nang TOUPA na om chih azata uh. Kimaituah hial a muh in na om a, atung uah na meipi a-om a; sun in meipi dingh, zan in meikuang in ama uh lah na pi zel hi.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

paite: Hiai mite na thahgamleh na minthanna za namte'n,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite kichiam a, achiam gam a api theih louh ziak in gamdai ah athatta, achi ding uh.
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

paite: Tu in ka hon ngen ahi, ka TOUPA thilhihtheihna hih thupi in om hen, thu a na gen tak dungzui in;
english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

paite: TOUPA lungneltak, migitna hau, thulimlouhnate, tatleknate ngaidam zel; moh a asehte khah ngei loupa, pate thulimlouhna tate, tate tasawnte, suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel ahi, na chi hi.
english: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

paite: Na migitna athupi bang ngei leh Aigupta gam a pan tutan a na ngaihdam bang in mipite thulimlouhna ngaidam in," achi hi.
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Na thu bang in ka ngaidam hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

paite: Himahleh kei ka hin bang in TOUPA thupina in leitung pumpi adimsak ding.
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—

paite: Aigupta gam leh gamdai a ka thupina leh ka thillamdang hihte mu a, huchi pipi a leng sawmveitak hon ze-et lailai a, ka thu zui lou lai mi tengteng in;
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

paite: apipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam huai gam amu kei hial ding uh. Alak ua kei hon ngaineute mawngmawng in leng amu sam kei ding uh.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

paite: Ka sikha Kaleb in bel lungsim dang aput a, ahon zuih taktak ziak in, amah zaw ava hohna gam ah ka pilut dia, asuante'n huai aluah ding uh.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

paite: Phaizang a Amalekte leh Kanaante teng ahih ziak un, zingchiang in kihei unla, Tuipi San lampi lam gamdai ah lut un," achi hi.
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
heading: Aphun Ziak Un TOUPA'N Mipite Agawt
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mithulim lou omkhawmte, ka tung a phunphunte bang tan ahia ka dohzoh ding? Israel suante phunna, ka tung a aphunnate uh ka za hi.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

paite: Akiang uah, ka hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka bilbuk ngei a na gen bang un na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

paite: Na luang uh gamdai ah apuk dia; na lak ua simsa mi tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam ka tung a phun teng,
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

paite: ban zak hial a, ka hon omsak ding, ka chih gam ah Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal na lut kei ding uh,
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Himahleh mat ding lel ahi ding uh, na chih uh na tate uh ka pilut dia, na ngaihneu uh gam athei ding uhi.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

paite: "Nou bel na luang uh hiai gamdai ah apuk ding hi.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

paite: Na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avakvai ding ua, gamdai a na luangte uh amawk man masiah na kizuakna uh amau athuakloh ding uhi.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

paite: Gam na va etkhiak ni zah uh, ni sawmli, ni khat tang in kum khat zel, kum sawmli sung na tatlekna uh na thuakloh ding ua, huchi in ka thuchiam ka hihlamdan dan na thei ding uhi.
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

paite: Kei TOUPA'N migilou omkhawm, kei hon kalh a omkhawmte tung ah hiai ka hih ngei ding ka na chi khinta hi. Hiai gamdai ah amangthang ding ua. Huai ah asi ding uh," achi hi.
english: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

paite: Gam enkhe dia Mosi misawl hong kik nawnte'n, gam omdan ahoih lou lam agen un amah tung ah omkhawmte aphunsak hi.
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

paite: Huai gam omdan ahoih lou lam agente ngei TOUPA ma ah hipi in asita uhi.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

paite: Gam enkhe dia hohte lak a Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb bel asi kei uhi.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

paite: Mosi in huai thute Israel suan tengteng ahilh a; huchi in mipite'n nakpitak in asuun uhi.
heading: Gam Dou Tupna Masa / (Diu 1.41-46)
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

paite: Huchi in zingsangpi in athou ua, tang vum ah ahohtou ua, "Ngai in, hiai ah ka hong pai uh. TOUPA'N ahon chiamna mun ah ka hoh ding uh, ka na khialta uhi," achi uhi.
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised; for we have sinned.”

paite: Mosi in, "Tu a bangziak a TOUPA thupiak palsat na hi ua? Hiai alohching kei ding.
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

paite: Na kiang ua TOUPA a-om louh ziak in hohtou kei un; melmate thah a na omlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

paite: "Na ma uah Amalekte leh Kanaante a-om uhi. Namsau a thah na hi phet ding uh. TOUPA na lehngatsan tak ziak un na kiang uah TOUPA a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following Yahweh; therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

paite: Himahleh mualvum a hoh atum ua; himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Mosi giahphual a pan apawtkhe kei uhi.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of Yahweh’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

paite: Huchi in huai mual a om Amalekte leh Kanaante hong kuansuk in, ahong dou ua, Hormah tanpha in asatpuk phengphung uhi.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.
